name: Cocoa-Nut Cake
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Cut up and wash a cocoa-nut, and grate as much of it as will weigh a pound
Beat fifteen eggs very light; and then beat into them, gradually, the sugar
Add by degrees the cocoa-nut; and lastly, a handful of sifted flour
Stir the whole very hard, and bake it either in a large tin pan, or in little tins
The oven should be rather quick

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut up and wash a cocoa-nut, and grate as much of it as will weigh a pound
2. Powder a pound of loaf-sugar
3. Beat fifteen eggs very light; and then beat into them, gradually, the sugar
4. Add by degrees the cocoa-nut; and lastly, a handful of sifted flour
5. Stir the whole very hard, and bake it either in a large tin pan, or in little tins
6. The oven should be rather quick
